content.short: Blockchain engineering firm building DeFi, tokenization and stablecoin systems since 2016.
content.description: Protofire designs, builds and runs on-chain systems for banks, exchanges, asset managers, fintechs and protocols, covering lending, vaults, tokenized funds, stablecoin settlement and prediction markets. It has delivered more than 250 projects since 2016, secured over $2 billion across 120+ networks, and maintains open-source developer tools used by a million developers. It also deploys core infrastructure, such as Safe multisigs, for new chains like Plasma.
content.meta: Protofire engineers DeFi, tokenization and stablecoin systems for institutions, with 250+ projects since 2016.
